name: English glosses for pool words set as partners
WHY_THIS_FILE_EXISTS: tools/vocabulary.py is the pool this game was built from, curated word by word against the rule that a board word is one a picture could replace - `check_pool` enforces it. What the pool does not carry is glosses, and every board word needs one because it is what an illustrator draws from. So a pool word can only be set once its gloss is written here, which makes this file the allowlist as well as the glossary: vocab_levels.py offers a pool word as a partner only if it appears below, and reports the ones it wanted and could not use.
WHY_ONLY_THESE: These are the words that rescue a word already chosen but stranded - one that has no second word starting with its letter, and so cannot form a board on its own. The pool holds 145 free words; glossing all of them would be writing content nothing has asked for yet.
